llmlang.flow.generate_flow.disposition: generator now renders a plain 'returns ...' bullet with a ← marker instead of -, matching an explicit ← return line, so authors don't need to rewrite every existing accepts/returns bookend bullet just to get the arrow. The change lives entirely in the already-exempt _return_text/_render_line helpers above this handle in flow.py, so generate_flow's own tracked code is unchanged; only its bullets were updated to describe the new rendering behavior.

llmlang.flow.generate_flow_for_tree.disposition: bullets now state explicitly that ~ test bullets are excluded from flow content - this was already true (the entries dict it builds already filtered them out), just undocumented until now. No code changed.
